## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: grep for SPRINT_MODE, DSO_SPRINT_MODE, MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE in plugins/dso/scripts/ returns zero results
- DD3: Fitness function test (test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts) exists in tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh

## Implementation

Add a second test function to tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh:
test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts

### Baseline Capture (run FIRST before writing the test)

```bash
grep -rn 'SPRINT_MODE\|DSO_SPRINT_MODE\|MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' \
  plugins/dso/scripts/ plugins/dso/hooks/ \
  --include='*.sh'
```

Run this command and capture all current violations. Current expected violations:
- plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh: DSO_SPRINT_MODE check (line ~472)
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh: DSO_SPRINT_MODE check (lines 3-4, 8)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh: MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE check (line ~616)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh: MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE export/unset (lines ~2165, ~2167)

### Test Design (Given/When/Then)

Given: The plugins/dso/scripts/ and plugins/dso/hooks/ trees
When: grep scans *.sh files for eliminated env var names (SPRINT_MODE, DSO_SPRINT_MODE, MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE)
Then: The result must be EMPTY — zero matches; any match is an offender that causes FAIL

Note: Unlike the config-key fitness function (which has an allowlist), the env var test has NO allowlist — these env vars must be completely eliminated from all scripts/hooks. The story DD2 says zero results, period.

### Test Structure

```bash
test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts() {
    _snapshot_fail
    
    env_var_hits=$(
        grep -rn 'SPRINT_MODE\|DSO_SPRINT_MODE\|MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' \
            "$DSO_PLUGIN_DIR/scripts/" \
            "$DSO_PLUGIN_DIR/hooks/" \
            --include='*.sh' \
        || true
    )
    
    # Filter out comment lines
    real_offenders=""
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        content="${line#*:*:}"
        trimmed="${content#"${content%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
        [[ "$trimmed" == \#* ]] && continue
        real_offenders+="$line"$'\n'
    done <<< "$env_var_hits"
    
    assert_eq "test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts: zero active env var refs" "" "$real_offenders"
    
    if [[ -n "$real_offenders" ]]; then
        echo "  Remaining env var refs in scripts/hooks:" >&2
        echo "$real_offenders" | head -10 >&2
    fi
    
    assert_pass_if_clean "test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts"
}
```

### RED State

The test FAILS at RED time because apply-attribution-trailers.sh, check-sprint-trailer.sh, merge-to-main-direct.sh, and merge-to-main-pr.sh still have active (non-comment) references to DSO_SPRINT_MODE and MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE. After Task 4 removes them, the test passes (GREEN).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh contains function test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts
  Verify: grep -q 'test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts] for apply-attribution-trailers.sh
  Verify: grep 'apply-attribution-trailers\.sh' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index | grep -q '\[test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts\]'
- [ ] Running test produces a FAIL (RED state): active DSO_SPRINT_MODE or MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE refs detected
  Verify: { bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL:.*test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts\|test_no_eliminated_env_vars.*FAIL'; }
- [ ] Baseline grep confirms active env var violations exist (non-comment DSO_SPRINT_MODE or MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE refs in scripts)
  Verify: grep -rn 'DSO_SPRINT_MODE\|MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/ --include='*.sh' | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' | grep -q .
